preamble: Hardening of the voiced alveolo-palatal fricative [ʑ] to the voiced retroflex fricative [ʐ]. The clearest documented case is Russian, where the marginal long soft [ʑː] of words like дрожжи 'yeast' and вожжи 'reins' is increasingly replaced by hard [ʐː]; the soft pronunciation survives mainly in the conservative Moscow standard.

examples.note: Both pronunciations are current; the hard [ʐː] replaces the conservative Moscow soft [ʑː].
Same replacement of soft [ʑː] by hard [ʐː] in the plural of вожжа.
